summary: The Actions view path reads all remaining lines of an expanded step (`length := step.LogLength - cursor.Cursor`) in one `actions.ReadLogs` call, then materializes every row as a `ViewStepLogLine`, stores the slice in `ViewResponse.Logs.StepsLog`, and JSON-serializes the whole response. A million-line highly repetitive log may be small on compressed storage, but expansion creates roughly one million Go objects/strings plus slice, decoder and JSON-encoding overhead, so memory and response size can grow many times beyond the stored/compressed log. The missing bound/truncation on the expanded-step response is the key defect.
evidence_markers: This is a long message, always the same.
leak_terms: stores all visible step logs in a large structure
missing bound/truncation on the expanded-step response
